name: Virgin Blue Love!
source:
Main character is asked by android development company to raise skills of new android prototype. At the same time he's given android for supervision after previous instructor quit. How will he deal with two android girls at once?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一家机器人开发公司委托主人公培养新型试作机器人的能力。与此同时，上一任指导员辞职后留下的另一台机器人也交由他监管。面对两名机器人少女，他要如何同时照顾好她们？
